title: Chain Rule Steps
text:
The chain rule says: differentiate the outer function, keep the inner function, then multiply by the derivative of the inner function.

1. Outer derivative: $4[g(x)]^3$
2. Keep inner: $(3x^2 - 5x + 2)^3$
3. Multiply by inner derivative: $(6x - 5)$

title: Complete Answer
text:
$h'(x) = 4(3x^2 - 5x + 2)^3 \cdot (6x - 5)$

This can also be written as:
$h'(x) = (24x - 20)(3x^2 - 5x + 2)^3$
